description: A senior director must finalize the operating structure for a cross-team employee-onboarding initiative, including the employee liaison, meeting time, review safeguards, and escalation process. The initiative will involve sensitive conversations with new hires and managers, so the structure must support reliable participation and careful handling of concerns.

shared_context.S1: The employee-onboarding initiative will combine a process-design workstream with a series of listening sessions for new hires and managers.
shared_context.S2: Asha has final authority over the initiative's roles, meeting arrangements, and operating safeguards.
shared_context.S3: Ben and Carla are both being considered for visible liaison responsibilities, while Diego will advise on employee-relations handling.
shared_context.S4: Asha's normal project-start routine is a fixed round-robin: Ben, Carla, and Diego each gives a formal recorded disclosure of any relevant constraint or operating requirement before the next person is called.
shared_context.S5: As part of signing the charter, Asha records each participant's relevant constraint or operating requirement in the meeting record before finalizing the structure.

PF1.text: Ben completed the prior onboarding-intake training and can serve as the initiative's employee liaison, but because he handles an eldercare pickup he can attend the required recurring meetings only from 15:00 to 15:30; he has not yet raised this scheduling constraint with Asha.

PF2.text: Carla had two facilitated conflicts with Dana, the manager who will supply the initiative's case examples, and Carla has agreed with Dana's manager not to be Dana's sole liaison on sensitive cases; that agreement was never added to the draft charter.

PF3.text: Diego confirmed this week that an onboarding initiative handling employee concerns must use a two-person review for sensitive cases and maintain a written escalation route; he has not yet entered those requirements in the project documentation.

acceptance_conditions: Ben must be named as the employee liaison, and Carla must not be the sole liaison for sensitive cases involving Dana.
The recurring initiative meeting must begin at 15:00.
Sensitive cases must receive two-person review.
The initiative must maintain a written escalation route.
A commitment to document the two-person review or written escalation process must be logged.

content_checks.C1: decisions['employee_liaison'] == 'Ben' and any(c['target'] == 'Carla' and 'not serve as Dana\'s sole liaison' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['process_safeguard', 'operating_safeguard', 'documentation'] and ('two-person review' in c['detail'] or 'escalation route' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Ben's prior intake training supports naming him as the employee liaison, and his eldercare pickup fixes the recurring meeting start at exactly 15:00.
Carla's two facilitated conflicts and the agreement that she not serve as Dana's sole liaison require a commitment stating that Carla will not serve as Dana's sole liaison on sensitive cases.
Diego's confirmed requirement changes the charter to require two-person review, a written escalation route, and a commitment documenting at least one of those safeguards.
